title.value: Practical Dynamic SC-Flip Polar Decoders: Algorithm and Implementation
title.justification: The title directly represents the main focus and contributions of the paper, which are about the algorithm and implementation aspects of Dynamic SC-Flip Polar Decoders.
title.quote: Practical Dynamic SC-Flip Polar Decoders: Algorithm and Implementation

analysis.description: This paper proposes simplifications and approximations for Dynamic SC-Flip (DSCF) Polar Decoders to make them practically feasible for hardware implementation, focusing on reducing computational complexity without significantly impacting error-correction performance. The work introduces Fast-DSCF decoding, which incorporates special node decoding techniques and presents a hardware architecture embodying the proposed simplifications. The proposed solutions demonstrate improved area and energy efficiency compared to state-of-the-art decoders.

type.justification: The paper is empirical as it discusses the implementation and testing of algorithms, providing performance, area-efficiency, and energy-efficiency results based on simulations and ASIC synthesis.
type.quote: The Fast-DSCF decoders synthesized using TSMC 65nm CMOS technology can achieve a 1.25, 1.06 and 0.93 Gbps throughput for ω ∈ {1, 2, 3}, respectively. Compared to the state-of-the-art fast CA-SCL decoders with equivalent FER performance, the proposed decoders are up to 5.8× more area-efficient.

name.justification: The research is primarily focused on polar codes, which are used in telecommunications, specifically in the context of 5G wireless communications.
name.quote: Index Terms—Polar codes, 5G, energy efficiency, Dynamic SCFlip, wireless communications, hardware implementation.

name.justification: The research involves detailed hardware implementation strategies for the proposed decoding algorithms.
name.quote: The proposed hardware takes advantage of all the proposed simplifications. In addition, we present further simplifications, such as metric normalization and sorter length reduction.

name.justification: The paper discusses error correction performance improvements for polar codes, which are a type of error-correcting code.
name.quote: SC-Flip (SCF) is a low-complexity polar code decoding algorithm with improved performance, and is an alternative to high-complexity (CRC)-aided SC-List (CA-SCL) decoding.
